lines.zh: 我横着走，脚在石面上刮。
lines.en: I walk sideways, claws scraping stone.
My eight legs step in halting rhythm.

lines.zh: 岩壁太陡，我只能横着爬。
lines.en: The cliff's too steep; I crawl sideways.

lines.zh: 我从一块尖石跳到下一块。
lines.en: I hop from one sharp stone to the next.

lines.zh: 我的壳在风里敲出响声。
lines.en: My shell knocks in the wind.
I edge around a deep fissure.
I cross the ridge sideways.

lines.zh: 我的钳子举着，随时能夹。
lines.en: My claws stay raised, ready to pinch.
I knock a stone loose.
I move between the jagged peaks.
Clouds lie below my feet.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，可掉不下去。
lines.en: I climb slowly, but I don't fall.
There's frost on my shell.
I work my way up a stone seam.

lines.zh: 我有一只钳子比另一只大。
lines.en: One of my claws is larger than the other.

lines.zh: 我一路都把身子贴得很紧。
lines.en: I keep my body pressed close all the way.

lines.zh: 我趴在岩顶上，一动不动。
lines.en: I cling to the summit, unmoving.
The wind is strong; I press lower.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在石头上转着。
lines.en: My eyes swivel on their stalks.
I tap a stone with my claw.
The air up here is cold.

lines.zh: 我的壳和岩石一个颜色。
lines.en: My shell is the color of the rock.

lines.zh: 我在等一个爬上来的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone to climb up.
I tuck my legs under me for warmth.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的壳上，没有化。
lines.en: Snow lands on my shell and doesn't melt.

lines.zh: 石缝里冒出一串小气泡。
lines.en: A string of small bubbles rises from the crevice.

lines.zh: 我听见下面有石头滚落。
lines.en: I hear stones falling below.

lines.zh: 这个位置很好，能看很远。
lines.en: Good spot. I can see a long way.

lines.zh: 我把一只钳子搁在石头上。
lines.en: I rest a claw on the stone.
I shift to another spot, slowly.
You climbed up. Brave.
My claw is bigger than your hand.

lines.zh: 你别踩那块石头，是我的。
lines.en: Don't step on that stone. It's mine.
I'm looking at what you carry.
My shell will turn a blade.
Try one more step up.

lines.zh: 我举起眼柄，看清你的鞋。
lines.en: I raise my eyestalks and study your boots.
The wind is strong; you can't stand firm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地侧过身，看着你。
lines.en: I turn sideways to watch you.
You're on my cliff.

lines.zh: 尖峭山峰的石缝，是我的窝。
lines.en: Crevices on the steep peaks are my home.
I back to the edge of the fissure.

lines.zh: 断了一条腿，我还能横着走。
lines.en: One leg gone; I can still walk sideways.
I make a small sound.
That slid me half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的钳子有点张不开了。
lines.en: My claw won't open properly.

lines.zh: 我把身子缩进壳里一点。
lines.en: I shrink a little into my shell.

lines.zh: 你这一下砸得比我想的重。
lines.en: That blow landed heavier than I judged.
Another step back and I fall.
I grip the wall and steady myself.
There's food in that pack.

lines.zh: 那块铁矿，离我的钳子很近。
lines.en: That iron ore is very close to my pincers.
I sidle a little closer.

lines.zh: 这点味道，在风里也很清楚。
lines.en: That scent is clear even in the wind.
I extend one claw.
Hold still; I'm still weighing it.
I snap once and miss.
I'll take these to hoard.
Rock isn't a good place to eat.

lines.zh: 尖峭山峰上，我的壳是磐石。
lines.en: On the jagged peaks, my shell is boulder.
You hit me like a rock corner.

lines.zh: 我的壳把你顶开了一点。
lines.en: My shell shoves you back.
I sidestep half a pace.
Don't push; there's a drop under me.
We collide, both of us planted.
You step on me, and my shell clicks.
I grip the wall with a claw.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我掉了几块碎石。
lines.en: That shook some rubble loose.
I slide half a foot along the rock.

lines.zh: 你和我挤在一条窄道上。
lines.en: We're jammed on a narrow ledge.

lines.zh: 另一只从石缝里爬出来。
lines.en: Another climbs out of a fissure.

lines.zh: 我们的壳碰在一起，很响。
lines.en: Our shells clack together.
Its claws are thicker than mine.
We cling to the cliff together.
It sidles slowly toward me.
Our legs stand crossed.
Wind rattles both our shells.
This cliff is enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着下面的云。
lines.en: Together we watch the clouds below.
There'll be one more crab on this peak.

lines.zh: 我用钳子夹起一块东西。
lines.en: I pinch up something in my claw.
There's ore in this stone.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进壳下面的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it under my shell.
It's slippery; I grab twice.

lines.zh: 这枚东西在石缝里发亮。
lines.en: Something glints in the fissure.
I won't eat this, but I want it.
I hold it up high.
The stone's mine. Leave it.
I crushed it. A pity.
I haul it to the summit.
You crushed the stone I chose.
I turn my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我的两只钳子都举起来了。
lines.en: Both my claws are up.
This cliff is mine.

lines.zh: 你跑不快，这里全是石头。
lines.en: You can't run; it's all stone here.
I come sideways. Don't move.
You won't get through my shell.
I'm steadier on rock than you.
My legs have a firm grip.
You came up too early.
The rock crab sidles across.
I pick a path among the stones.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我的眼睛就跟到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my eyes follow.
I know this rock.
I press myself to the face.
The wind doesn't hinder me.
You're gripping the stone hard.
I've worked above you.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石会先出卖你。
lines.en: The loose stones will betray you first.

lines.zh: 我等你爬到没有落脚的地方。
lines.en: I wait until you run out of footholds.

lines.zh: 我的钳子夹在你的腿上。
lines.en: My claw closes on your leg.
That was a solid grip.
My shell rams you, hard.
You back away and your heel slips.
I hammer your hand with a claw.

lines.zh: 你抓紧了石头，没掉下去。
lines.en: You catch the rock and don't fall.
I swing sideways again.
That makes you lose your grip.

lines.zh: 我的腿扒住了你的靴子。
lines.en: My legs hook your boots.
I shove you toward the drop.

lines.zh: 岩顶的石缝里钻出个壳。
lines.en: A shell emerges from a summit fissure.

lines.zh: 这一片尖峰上多了几只。
lines.en: A few of us appear on these peaks.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头下面翻上来。
lines.en: I flip up from under a stone.
A row of claw marks in the frost.

lines.zh: 风里传来壳碰石的声音。
lines.en: Shell on stone sounds in the wind.
I crawl slowly onto the ridge.
I stop at the highest point.

lines.zh: 我的壳和岩石融在一起。
lines.en: My shell blends with the rock.

lines.zh: 这山太高，只有我上得来。
lines.en: Only I can climb this high.
I shake the snow off my legs.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，响了一声。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and it ticks.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁掉下去，砸在石头上。
lines.en: I fall off the cliff and hit stone.
Water fills my shell and I can't move.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从岩壁上震下来。
lines.en: The blast shakes me off the cliff.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在我的壳上，弹开。
lines.en: Something strikes my shell and bounces.
That spell numbs my legs.
There's little to eat on this peak.

lines.zh: 雷打在我壳上，一路窜下去。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and runs down.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从岩壁上扯开。
lines.en: The void tears me off the cliff.
